messages:
Maya R: Quick sync idea: emit provisional billing lines when we detect missing final events for >10m. Mark them clearly provisional and support reconcile actions (commit/adjust/void).

Kevin L: Important: avoid silent double-charges. Each provisional needs provenance_id and idempotent reconcile path.

Priya S: Console UX: show a small orange "Provisional" pill on preview lines, tooltip explaining these are estimates and may change. Add a filter ?provisional=true and a "Force commit" action (internal-only) with audit comment.

Jonah M: Schema additions: provisional:boolean, provenance_id:string, estimate_tokens:int, estimate_cents:int, provisional_ttl_seconds:int, match_type:provenance|fingerprint. Reconcile endpoint accepts action plus final_amount_cents. PATCH semantics for partial adjustments.

Kevin L: Metrics: billing.provisional_emitted_total, billing.provisional_committed_total, billing.provisional_adjusted_total, billing.provisional_voided_total, billing.provisional_reconcile_latency_p50_p95. Alert if reconcile_delta_pct_p95 > 2%.

Maya R: Rollout: feature flag billing.provisionals.v1, tenant opt-in. Canary small set, monitor false_match_rate. Fallback fingerprint allowed but mark match_type=fallback and widen review window.

Priya S: Console export behavior: hide provisional lines by default for external exports; internal exports have "Include provisional" toggle. Add a help modal and update FAQ: "Why did my preview change?"

Jonah M: SDK changes: helper to emit X-Provenance header; fallback fingerprint uses tenant+route+approx_ts hashed. Add unit tests for split-final events to ensure adjust works.

billing-bot: deploy-bot: billing-service v2.21.0 deployed to staging; flag billing.provisionals.v1=false.

Maya R: I'll author the design doc and open PRs for schema + console + SDK. Tagging @Kevin L @Priya S for review.
